title: Wraith — the war room that builds itself

segments.caption: Every incident is different
segments.line: Every incident is different. Every dashboard is the same: built months ago, for somebody else's crisis.

segments.caption: Tell it what's happening
segments.line: So we built Wraith. Tell it what's happening, and the war room builds itself.

segments.caption: Three agents, three partial views
segments.line: A CrewAI flow routes it to three agents, and each one sees only part of the picture: the instruments, our playbooks through Parasail, and the live web through You.com.

segments.caption: The commander breaks the tie
segments.line: They don't agree. The commander sees only their briefs, and it breaks the tie: evacuate.

segments.caption: Parasail writes the interface
segments.line: None of this existed fifteen seconds ago. Parasail is writing the interface, for this incident, while you watch.

segments.caption: Operate it. One acts on it.
segments.line: It's a console, not a picture. Start the evacuation, and the alert rewrites itself. One finds the Discord action and builds the request: list, find, execute.

segments.caption: The live web changes the decision
segments.line: Same agents, same model. Wildfire smoke over the Bay. Without the live web, it would have moved three hundred people. With You.com, it read today's air quality, and they stayed.

segments.caption: No false alarms
segments.line: And when it's just a crowd of people, it knows. No false alarm.

segments.caption: Incidents are the market
segments.line: Halloween is the demo. Incidents are the market: on-call engineers, venues, emergency teams.

segments.caption: github.com/vnmoorthy/wraith
segments.line: Every incident gets its own war room in seconds. Every claim has a receipt. A human presses the button. This is Wraith.
